description: Start a cloud build of a builder app for one platform. provider picks where it runs and who pays: github (the customer's own GitHub Actions minutes, 0 credits), eas_own (the customer's own Expo account, 0 credits), eas_ours (AppForShare on Expo: iOS and Android cost builder credits), self_hosted (AppForShare Linux, Android only, credits: a signed release APK and AAB made on our build servers, signed with the app's own key, then added as an AppForShare build with an install link, QR code and testers; each build runs on a fresh build machine of its own that is deleted afterwards and usually takes about 10 to 15 minutes; per plan a daily cap of Linux builds applies, Team builds go first). Without provider the app's or the workspace's saved choice is used; with none the call fails and lists the options, so nothing is spent on a guess. Tell the person the cost from builder_status first, ask, and pass confirm: true. Follow a build with builder_build. A build that fails on a paid provider, or on our side, is refunded. Developer role. github and eas_own on every plan (iOS too) for an app that has code; eas_ours and self_hosted on Pro and Team (on Free they answer 403 code BUILDER_DESIGN_ONLY), and eas_ours iOS needs the app's Apple signing saved in the dashboard (Builds, Apple signing: the provisioning profile, plus a .p12 when the workspace has no matching signing certificate). github needs the app's repository picked first (builder_github, set_builder_github): each build pushes the current version to it as a new commit (a pull request on its own branch when the branch has commits AppForShare did not make) and runs the AppForShare workflow there; github iOS also needs the Apple Team ID. eas_own needs the customer's Expo access token saved in the dashboard (App builder, Where builds run). Android builds on github, eas_own and eas_ours are signed with the app's own key, the same as Linux builds. Every provider brings the app file back as an AppForShare build with an install link.
name: start_builder_build
title: Start an app builder build
